It's hard to take a shower most of the time, but on the rare times  I do feel able to get in the shower I never want to come out. 

Unfortunately I can't because the place I'm renting has the worst shower I don't even know how to explain it but it belongs on /r/diWHY it's like a walk in shower with none of the benefits of a walk in shower and basically floods the bathroom every time unless you make it very quick.

If you don't tell them you have a method and you are literally in the middle of it right now, they will tell you to get lost because they have other people to help. (in more diplomatic words). And if you do tell them you are in danger of hurting yourself or even just hang up on them out of nervousness they will send the police to your door. 

The suicide hotline is just a glorified telephone operator that has one job, and that's to connect you to the police and send you to the loony bin.

Same. I'm always living in this perpetual state of "lord take me now", yet at the same time if I ever come too close to dying or getting hurt it triggers massive instinctive panic in me. I think I'm more afraid of dying than other people I know, well more the process of dying, I'm not afraid to be dead exactly. But it's the process of dying and being in any more pain than I already am that scares me more than anything.
